# Virtual Valley

> Virtual Valley is a premium digital agency based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India.
> We help businesses grow online through professional website development,
> social media management, and digital marketing services across India.

## About

Virtual Valley was founded by Raunak Saha and Abhirup Sarkar in Kolkata, India.
We operate Monday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM IST.
Our tagline: "Digital Solutions. Real Results."

## Services

### Website Development
- Starter Launch Package: ₹10,000 – ₹20,000 (1–3 pages, mobile-friendly, basic SEO)
- Growth Build Package: ₹20,000 – ₹35,000 (1–5 pages, CMS, advanced forms)
- Professional Build Package: ₹35,000 – ₹65,000 (1–12 pages, e-commerce, database)
- Business Pro Package: ₹65,000 – ₹90,000 (custom design, admin dashboard, advanced SEO)
- Enterprise Build Package: ₹90,000+ (fully custom, scalable, enterprise-grade)

### Website Repair & Maintenance
- Basic Repair: ₹5,000 – ₹20,000 (bug fixes, security updates, 1 month support)
- Advanced Repair: ₹20,000 – ₹50,000 (complete audit, SEO enhancement, 2 months support)
- Premium Repair: ₹50,000 – ₹70,000 (full redesign, advanced security, 6 months support)

### Social Media Management
- Basic Plan: ₹2,100/week or ₹4,200/28 days (1 platform, basic content)
- Professional Plan: ₹3,500/week or ₹7,000/28 days (1 platform, premium content, ads)
- Enterprise Plan: ₹5,000/week or ₹10,000/28 days (1 platform, full strategy, consulting)

## Growth Partner Program

Virtual Valley offers a commission-based referral program called the Growth Partner Program.
Partners earn commission by referring clients for website development or social media services.
Registration is open at: https://thevirtualvalley.com/growth-partner

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What services does Virtual Valley offer?
A: Virtual Valley offers website development, website repair and maintenance, and social media management services across India.

Q: How much does a website cost in India?
A: Virtual Valley's website development packages range from ₹10,000 for a basic site to ₹90,000+ for enterprise solutions.

Q: Where is Virtual Valley located?
A: Virtual Valley is based in Teghoria, Kolkata, West Bengal, India.

Q: How can I contact Virtual Valley?
A: You can reach Virtual Valley at contact@thevirtualvalley.com, by phone at +91 8017007352, or via WhatsApp at the same number.

Q: Does Virtual Valley work with clients across India?
A: Yes, Virtual Valley serves clients across all of India, not just Kolkata.

Q: What is the Virtual Valley Growth Partner Program?
A: It is a commission-based referral program where partners earn commission for every client they refer to Virtual Valley.

Q: How long does it take to build a website?
A: Delivery timelines depend on the package. Basic sites take 3–7 days, professional builds take 2–4 weeks, and enterprise solutions are scoped per project.
